# Deals

Manage sales deals in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::deals()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Deals\Deals` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `deals.create`
- `deals.delete`
- `deals.info`
- `deals.list`
- `deals.lose`
- `deals.move`
- `deals.update`
- `deals.win`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `created_before` | Filter by creation date (inclusive) |
| `customer` | Filter by customer (requires type and id) |
| `estimated_closing_date` | Filter by exact closing date |
| `estimated_closing_date_from` | Filter by closing date from (inclusive) |
| `estimated_closing_date_until` | Filter by closing date until (inclusive) |
| `ids` | Array of deal UUIDs to filter by |
| `phase_id` | Filter by specific phase UUID |
| `pipeline_ids` | Array of pipeline UUIDs |
| `responsible_user_id` | Filter by responsible user UUID (string or array) |
| `status` | Filter by deal status (open, won, lost) — a string is wrapped into an array |
| `term` | Search term (filters on title, reference, and customer name) |
| `updated_since` | Filter by last update date (inclusive) |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `created_at` | Sort by creation date |
| `weighted_value` | Sort by weighted deal value |

## Includes

| Endpoint | Includes |
|---|---|
| `list()` | `custom_fields`, `second_responsible_user` |
| `info()` | `second_responsible_user` |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `CURRENCIES` | `BAM`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `CLP`, `CNY`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `INR`, `ISK`, `JPY`, `MAD`, `MXN`, `NOK`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR` |
| `CUSTOMER_TYPES` | `contact`, `company` |
| `STATUSES` | `open`, `won`, `lost` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `lead`, `title`, `summary`, `source_id`, `department_id`, `responsible_user_id`, `second_responsible_user_id`, `estimated_value`, `estimated_probability`, `estimated_closing_date`, `currency`, `custom_fields`, `purchase_order_number` |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List deals with filtering, sorting, pagination and sideloading

Unknown filter keys throw rather than being forwarded — the API ignores
keys it does not recognise and returns a full unfiltered result set with
a 200, which is indistinguishable from a correct response.

- `$filters` — Filters to apply — see $commonFilters
- `$options` — sort, sort_order, page_size, page_number, include

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When a filter key or sort field is not supported

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null): array
```

Get deal information

deals.info accepts one include, `second_responsible_user`. Custom fields
are returned without being asked; the lead, responsible user, department,
phase and source are always returned as references.

- `$id` — Deal UUID
- `$includes` — second_responsible_user

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException` When an include is not valid for this endpoint

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a new deal

Optional pass-through fields include:
- purchase_order_number (string|null): the customer's purchase order number

- `$data` — Deal data

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update a deal

Optional pass-through fields include:
- purchase_order_number (string|null): the customer's purchase order number

- `$id` — Deal UUID
- `$data` — Data to update

**Throws** `InvalidArgumentException`

### `withCustomFields()`

```php
withCustomFields(): self
```

Fluent method to include custom fields — deals.list only; deals.info
returns them without being asked

### `withSecondResponsibleUser()`

```php
withSecondResponsibleUser(): self
```

Fluent method to include the second responsible user, on list() or
info(). Requires the second deal responsible feature on the account.

## Examples

Get all open deals:

```php
$deals = Teamleader::deals()->open();
```

Create a new deal:

```php
$deal = Teamleader::deals()->create([
                "lead" => ["customer" => ["type" => "company", "id" => "company-uuid"]],
                "title" => "New Business Deal",
                "estimated_value" => ["amount" => 10000, "currency" => "EUR"]
            ]);
```

Update a deal:

```php
$deal = Teamleader::deals()->update("deal-uuid", [
                "title" => "Updated Deal Title",
                "estimated_probability" => 0.75
            ]);
```

Mark a deal as won:

```php
$result = Teamleader::deals()->win("deal-uuid");
```

Mark a deal as lost with reason:

```php
$result = Teamleader::deals()->lose("deal-uuid", "reason-uuid", "Price too high");
```

Move a deal to a different phase:

```php
$result = Teamleader::deals()->move("deal-uuid", "phase-uuid");
```

Get open deals with custom fields:

```php
$deals = Teamleader::deals()
                ->withCustomFields()
                ->list(["status" => ["open"]]);
```

Get deals sorted by weighted value:

```php
$deals = Teamleader::deals()->list([], ["sort" => "weighted_value", "sort_order" => "desc"]);
```

Get deals with custom fields sideloaded:

```php
$deals = Teamleader::deals()->list([], ["include" => "custom_fields"]);
```
